Key Nutrients: Protein (26g), Fat (14g), Carbohydrates (45g), Fiber (4g), Omega-3, Iodine, Calcium
Ingredients Required: Salted Salmon (Shake), Steamed Short-grain Japanese Rice, Miso paste, Dashi stock, Tofu, Wakame seaweed, Scallions, Nori sheets, Tamagoyaki (Japanese rolled omelet), Pickled Radish (Takuan)
Recipe Instructions: 1. Salt salmon fillet and grill on low heat till skin turns crispy. 2. Prepare miso soup by simmering dashi stock with tofu cubes, wakame, and whisking in miso paste. 3. Serve hot steamed rice accompanied by grilled salmon, miso soup, tamagoyaki slices, nori, and pickles.

Key Nutrients: Protein (14g), Fat (8g), Carbohydrates (38g), Fiber (7g), Probiotics, Vitamin K2, Iron
Ingredients Required: Fermented soybeans (Natto pack), Karashi (Japanese mustard), Vegan soy sauce / Tamari, Warm short-grain Japanese rice, Chopped scallions, Nori strips
Recipe Instructions: 1. Mix fermented natto beans with karashi mustard and soy sauce in a bowl; whip vigorously using chopsticks until sticky and frothy strands form. 2. Heap over warm steamed Japanese short-grain rice. 3. Garnish with finely chopped scallions and toasted nori strips.

Key Nutrients: Protein (10g), Fat (5g), Carbohydrates (39g), Fiber (3g), Calcium, Iron
Ingredients Required: Cooked Short-grain Japanese Rice, Kombu Dashi (Kelp broth), Cubed Silken Tofu, Edamame beans, Sweet corn, Gluten-free Soy sauce, Mirin, Toasted sesame oil, Salt
Recipe Instructions: 1. Simmer kombu dashi broth with gluten-free soy sauce, salt, and mirin. 2. Add cooked rice, silken tofu cubes, edamame, and corn kernels; cook for 8-10 minutes until rice softens and absorbs the broth. 3. Finish with a slight drizzle of toasted sesame oil (strictly no garlic, onion, or fish dashi).

Key Nutrients: Protein (12g), Fat (10g), Carbohydrates (42g), Fiber (2g), Choline, Vitamin B12
Ingredients Required: Hot steamed Japanese Rice, Pasteurized fresh egg, Soy sauce (Shoyu), Mirin, Furikake seasoning / Nori, Toasted sesame seeds
Recipe Instructions: 1. Scoop piping hot steamed Japanese short-grain rice into a bowl and make a small well in the center. 2. Crack a fresh egg into the well (or whip egg white until frothy first). 3. Drizzle soy sauce and mirin, toss briskly until rice turns creamy and pale yellow. Sprinkle furikake and sesame seeds.

Key Nutrients: Protein (18g), Fat (14g), Carbohydrates (58g), Fiber (6g), Calcium, Vit C
Ingredients Required: Ramen noodles, Vegetable broth, Miso paste, Soy milk, Pan-seared Tofu, Menma (seasoned bamboo shoots), Corn, Wood ear mushrooms (Kikurage), Ajitsuke Tamago (marinated ramen egg), Scallions, Chilli oil
Recipe Instructions: 1. Whisk miso paste, soy sauce, and warm soy milk into hot vegetable stock to create a rich creamy broth. 2. Boil ramen noodles al dente and place into a serving bowl. 3. Pour hot broth over noodles and arrange seared tofu, ramen egg half, sweet corn, bamboo shoots, and kikurage on top.

Key Nutrients: Protein (14g), Fat (8g), Carbohydrates (62g), Fiber (7g), Iron, Magnesium
Ingredients Required: Steamed Japanese Rice, Shelled Edamame, Sweet corn, Sliced Zucchini, Cubed Tofu, Kombu Dashi, Soy sauce, Mirin, Sugar, Cornstarch, Sesame seeds
Recipe Instructions: 1. Pan-fry tofu, zucchini, corn, and edamame in sesame oil. 2. Make teriyaki-style glazing sauce by boiling kombu dashi, soy sauce, mirin, sugar, and cornstarch slurry (no onion or garlic). 3. Toss veggies and tofu in sweet glaze, serve over a bowl of steamed rice, and sprinkle sesame seeds.

Key Nutrients: Protein (8g), Fat (16g), Carbohydrates (62g), Fiber (6g), Vit A, Vit C
Ingredients Required: Japanese rice, Kabocha squash slices, Sweet potato slices, Eggplant, Shishito peppers, Tempura flour, Ice-cold water, Kombu dashi, Soy sauce, Mirin, Sugar, Frying oil
Recipe Instructions: 1. Whisk tempura flour with ice-cold water into a light batter. 2. Dip Kabocha squash, sweet potato, eggplant, and shishito peppers in batter; deep fry in hot oil until light golden and crisp. 3. Simmer kombu dashi, soy sauce, mirin, and sugar for Tare sauce. Place crisp tempura over rice and drizzle sauce.

Key Nutrients: Protein (38g), Fat (24g), Carbohydrates (62g), Fiber (4g), Iron, Vit B6
Ingredients Required: Chicken breast cutlet, Panko breadcrumbs, Flour, Egg, Japanese Curry roux block, Onions, Carrots, Potatoes, Chicken stock, Soy sauce, Steamed Japanese Rice, Pickled Ginger (Beni Shoga)
Recipe Instructions: 1. Sauté onions, carrots, and potatoes; simmer in chicken stock, melt curry roux blocks till thick. 2. Dredge chicken breast in flour, egg wash, coat with crisp Panko breadcrumbs, and deep fry until golden. 3. Slice crispy cutlet, arrange next to steamed rice, and pour rich brown curry sauce over half cutlet.

Key Nutrients: Protein (7g), Fat (10g), Carbohydrates (36g), Fiber (4g), Vit C, Sodium
Ingredients Required: Gyoza wrappers, Shredded Cabbage, Minced Shiitake mushrooms, Carrots, Ginger, Sesame oil, Soy sauce, Cornstarch, Rice vinegar, Rayu (Japanese chili oil), Frying oil
Recipe Instructions: 1. Sauté shredded cabbage, mushrooms, carrots, and ginger with soy sauce and sesame oil until dry. 2. Fill gyoza wrappers, pleat edges on one side. 3. Pan-fry bottoms in a skillet till golden brown, splash water, cover with lid to steam cook. Serve with soy-vinegar-chili dipping sauce.

Dish Name: Jain Crisp Edamame & Sweet Corn Roll (Maki Sushi)
Key Nutrients: Protein (8g), Fat (5g), Carbohydrates (42g), Fiber (5g), Vit C, Folate
Ingredients Required: Seasoned Vinegared Sushi Rice, Nori sheets, Shelled Edamame mash, Sweet corn, Cucumber strips, Soy sauce, Pickled Ginger (Gari - if accepted, or omit), Wasabi
Recipe Instructions: 1. Lay nori on bamboo mat, spread seasoned sushi rice evenly leaving top margin. 2. Place edamame mash, sweet corn, and cucumber strips in a center line (strictly no avocado, onion, or radish). 3. Roll tightly using mat, slice into 8 pieces, and serve with soy sauce and wasabi.

Key Nutrients: Protein (5g), Fat (2g), Carbohydrates (46g), Fiber (3g), Energy
Ingredients Required: Steamed Japanese Short-grain Rice, Soy sauce, Mirin, Sesame oil, Toasted Sesame seeds
Recipe Instructions: 1. Shape warm cooked Japanese rice into compact triangular balls using damp hands. 2. Whisk soy sauce and mirin together. 3. Lightly oil a skillet/grill, sear rice triangles for 3-4 mins per side until light crust forms. Brush with soy-mirin glaze and cook until caramelized and crispy.

Key Nutrients: Protein (16g), Fat (14g), Carbohydrates (42g), Fiber (2g), Iodine, Selenium
Ingredients Required: Dashi-infused flour batter, Diced Octopus (Tako), Tenkasu (tempura scraps), Pickled red ginger (Beni Shoga), Scallions, Takoyaki sauce, Japanese Mayonnaise (Kewpie), Katsuobushi (Bonito flakes), Aonori (Seaweed powder)
Recipe Instructions: 1. Pour batter into spherical cavities of a hot Takoyaki pan; drop octopus pieces, tenkasu, scallions, and ginger inside. 2. Turn batter 90 degrees using skewers as it cooks, tucking in edges to form round balls. 3. Drizzle with Takoyaki sauce, Kewpie mayo, aonori, and dancing bonito flakes.

Key Nutrients: Protein (16g), Fat (12g), Carbohydrates (60g), Fiber (5g), Calcium, Iron
Ingredients Required: Firm Tofu, Broccoli, Bell peppers, Snow peas, Soy sauce, Mirin, Sake (or Apple juice), Sugar, Cornstarch, Sesame seeds, Steamed Rice
Recipe Instructions: 1. Press and cube firm tofu; coat in cornstarch and pan-fry in oil until golden crisp. 2. Sauté broccoli, bell peppers, and snow peas in wok. 3. Whisk soy sauce, mirin, sake, and sugar; simmer until glossy thick Teriyaki glaze forms. Toss tofu and veggies in glaze and serve over steamed rice.

Key Nutrients: Protein (7g), Fat (14g), Carbohydrates (58g), Fiber (5g), Vit A, Vit C
Ingredients Required: Zucchini slices, Bell peppers, Baby corn, Eggplant, Tempura flour, Ice water, Kombu Dashi, Soy sauce, Sugar, Oil, Steamed Japanese Rice
Recipe Instructions: 1. Prepare batter using tempura flour and ice-cold water. 2. Dip zucchini, bell peppers, baby corn, and eggplant; deep fry until golden crisp. 3. Simmer kombu dashi, gluten-free soy sauce, and sugar into dipping Tare. Serve crisp tempura over hot steamed rice.

Key Nutrients: Protein (6g), Fat (10g), Carbohydrates (40g), Fiber (8g), Potassium, Vit B6
Ingredients Required: Japanese Eggplants (Nasu), White Miso paste (Shiro Miso), Mirin, Sake, Sugar, Sesame oil, Toasted White & Black Sesame seeds
Recipe Instructions: 1. Halve eggplants lengthwise, score flesh crosswise, and pan-fry or roast with sesame oil until soft. 2. Whisk white miso, mirin, sake, and sugar over low heat until glossy glaze forms. 3. Spread thick miso glaze over eggplant halves and broil in oven for 3-4 mins until glazed surface bubbles and caramelizes.

Key Nutrients: Protein (36g), Fat (22g), Carbohydrates (44g), Fiber (2g), Omega-3, Vit D, Vit B12
Ingredients Required: Salmon fillets, Soy sauce, Mirin, Sake, Sugar, Cooking oil, Steamed Japanese Rice, Steamed Bok Choy, Sesame seeds
Recipe Instructions: 1. Sear salmon fillets skin-side down in a hot skillet until skin turns crispy, flip gently. 2. Whisk soy sauce, mirin, sake, and sugar; pour into skillet around salmon. 3. Simmer until sauce reduces into a thick mahogany glaze coating the fish. Serve over rice with steamed bok choy.

Key Nutrients: Protein (7g), Fat (12g), Carbohydrates (52g), Fiber (3g), Antioxidants, Calcium
Ingredients Required: Matcha ice cream, Anko (Sweet red bean paste), Shiratama Dango (Chewy rice dumplings), Vanilla soft serve / whipped cream, Cornflakes / Sponge cake cubes, Matcha powder
Recipe Instructions: 1. Layer bottom of tall glass with crunchy cornflakes or cake cubes. 2. Pipe vanilla cream, add a scoop of rich matcha ice cream and sweet red bean paste (anko). 3. Top with chewy shiratama dango rice balls and dust with pure ceremonial matcha powder.

Key Nutrients: Protein (5g), Fat (1g), Carbohydrates (48g), Fiber (3g), Iron
Ingredients Required: Shiratamako (Glutinous rice flour), Sugar, Water, Potato starch / Cornstarch, Anko (Sweetened Azuki red bean paste)
Recipe Instructions: 1. Roll sweet red bean paste into small smooth balls. 2. Mix glutinous rice flour, sugar, and water; steam or microwave for 3 minutes while stirring until shiny translucent dough forms. 3. Dust hands with potato starch, flatten warm mochi dough, wrap around red bean paste ball, and seal bottom.

Key Nutrients: Protein (4g), Fat (1g), Carbohydrates (48g), Fiber (4g), Vit C, Minerals
Ingredients Required: Kanten (Agar-agar jelly cubes), Anko (Sweet red bean paste), Kuromitsu (Black sugar syrup), Canned Mandarin oranges, Fresh Strawberries, Shiratama Dango, Matcha syrup
Recipe Instructions: 1. Boil agar-agar powder in water, pour into dish, set in fridge, and cut into clear translucent cubes. 2. Place kanten cubes in a bowl, top with a scoop of anko, mandarin oranges, strawberry halves, and chewy dango. 3. Drizzle rich Kuromitsu black sugar syrup over top.

Key Nutrients: Protein (10g), Fat (14g), Carbohydrates (52g), Fiber (1g), Calcium, Vit A
Ingredients Required: Egg yolks, Egg whites, Flour, Milk, Sugar, Baking powder, Vanilla extract, Butter, Powdered sugar, Maple syrup / Whipped cream, Fresh Berries
Recipe Instructions: 1. Whisk egg yolks, milk, flour, and vanilla. Whip egg whites with sugar into stiff glossy meringue peaks; fold gently into yolk batter. 2. Pipe tall mounds onto a greased pan on low heat, add water drops, cover with lid, steam-cook for 5 mins per side. 3. Dust with powdered sugar, serve with butter, maple syrup, and fresh berries.
